title: Advisor instructions and vague purpose references
summary: The examples are short service-note fragments about advisors telling customers what to do in the vehicle or app, plus a few isolated statements about serving customers or having no other purpose, so the topic does not support a clear sentiment reading.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews contain procedural guidance about retrieving a destination, linking devices, opening the app, and a few vague purpose-related statements that do not clearly express satisfaction or dissatisfaction.
